왜 이 제품인가

  • 1일 1회(1정) 섭취로 나이아신 4.5mg, 망간 0.9mg, 비타민 A 700μg, 비타민 B12 2.4μg, 비타민 B6 1.5mg, 비타민 C 30mg, 비타민 D 10μg, 아연 2.55mg, 판토텐산 5mg
  • 대장균군 음성 — 식약처 신고 기준 적합
  • 고유의 향미가 있고 이미,이취가 없는 보랏빛 하양색의 제피정제 · 주식회사 굿씨드 제조

원료별 공식 인정 기능성

  • 나이아신
    • 체내 에너지 생성에 필요
  • 망간
    • 항산화 작용을 하여 유해산소로부터 세포를 보호하는데 필요
    • 뼈 형성에 필요
    • 에너지 이용에 필요
  • 비타민 A
    • 어두운 곳에서 시각 적응을 위해 필요
    • 피부와 점막을 형성하고 기능을 유지하는데 필요
    • 상피세포의 성장과 발달에 필요
  • 비타민 B12
    • 정상적인 엽산 대사에 필요
  • 비타민 B6
    • 단백질 및 아미노산 이용에 필요
    • 혈액의 호모시스테인 수준을 정상으로 유지하는데 필요
  • 비타민 C
    • 결합조직 형성과 기능유지에 필요
    • 철의 흡수에 필요
    • 항산화 작용을 하여 유해산소로부터 세포를 보호하는데 필요
  • 비타민 D
    • 칼슘과 인이 흡수되고 이용되는데 필요
    • 뼈의 형성과 유지에 필요
    • 골다공증발생 위험 감소에 도움을 줌
  • 아연
    • 정상적인 면역기능에 필요
    • 정상적인 세포분열에 필요
  • 판토텐산
    • 지방, 탄수화물, 단백질 대사와 에너지 생성에 필요

Health Functional FoodNiacin 4.5mgManganese 0.9mgVitamin A 700μgVitamin B12 2.4μgVitamin B6 1.5mgVitamin C 30mgVitamin D 10μgZinc 2.55mgPantothenic acid 5mgOnce a day

엠브이5ANiacin · Manganese · Vitamin A · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Zinc · Pantothenic acid

Made by 주식회사 굿씨드 · Once a day · 1 tablet

This product combines 4.5mg of Niacin, 0.9mg of Manganese, 700μg of Vitamin A, 2.4μg of Vitamin B12, 1.5mg of Vitamin B6, 30mg of Vitamin C, 10μg of Vitamin D, 2.55mg of Zinc, 5mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 4.5mg Niacin, 0.9mg Manganese, 700μg Vitamin A, 2.4μg Vitamin B12, 1.5mg Vitamin B6, 30mg Vitamin C, 10μg Vitamin D, 2.55mg Zinc, 5mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 주식회사 굿씨드

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Manganese
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
    • Needed for bone formation
    • Needed for energy utilisation
  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 tablet per servingChew to take

Labelled standard

Niacin labelled (4.5mg / 1100mg), 80~150%
Manganese labelled (0.9mg / 1100mg), 80~150%
Vitamin A labelled (700μg / 1100mg), 80~150%
Vitamin B12 labelled (2.4μg / 1100mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (1.5mg / 1100mg), 80~150%
Vitamin C labelled (30mg / 1100mg), 80~150%
Vitamin D labelled (10μg / 1100mg), 80~180%
Zinc labelled (2.55mg / 1100mg), 80~150%
Pantothenic acid labelled (5mg / 1100mg), 80~180%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미,이취가 없는 보랏빛 하양색의 제피정제
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 2년까지

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Niacin · Manganese · Vitamin A · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Zinc · Pantothenic acid together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Consult a professional if you have hypercalcaemia or take medication · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

This product combines 4.5mg of Niacin, 0.9mg of Manganese, 700μg of Vitamin A, 2.4μg of Vitamin B12, 1.5mg of Vitamin B6, 30mg of Vitamin C, 10μg of Vitamin D, 2.55mg of Zinc, 5mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 4.5mg Niacin, 0.9mg Manganese, 700μg Vitamin A, 2.4μg Vitamin B12, 1.5mg Vitamin B6, 30mg Vitamin C, 10μg Vitamin D, 2.55mg Zinc, 5mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 주식회사 굿씨드

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Manganese
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
    • Needed for bone formation
    • Needed for energy utilisation
  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
